parsed.notes:
Who You Are and What We Need ask for candidate qualifications; neither is optional. What You Will Learn describes future learning and is excluded.
Seniority is null because the posting explicitly welcomes contributors of all seniorities and candidates at various experience levels, notwithstanding the conflicting 5+ years requirement.
Workflow automation is a literal interpretation of removing manual steps from flows; flagged because the wording also describes a working preference.
Building with AI is labeled AI/ML, not AI Coding Tools: no coding assistant or coding tool is explicitly requested.
Hardware methodology, EDA tools, scripting languages absent from the taxonomy, and technical flow documentation are recorded as unmapped. Interpersonal collaboration and clear writing as a soft skill are excluded.
No alternative group contains two mapped skills.
